name: lolm-nfet-ops
description: Repo-ops for the LOLM/NFET self-driving daily learned-update agent. Not published — the user-facing CLI is clients/cli (npm package lolm-cli).

scripts.test: npm test --workspace lolm-nfet-client && npm test --workspace lolm-cli && npm run test:release-gauntlet
scripts.help: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.name+' — private repo-ops, not the product CLI.\n'); console.log('Product CLI (what users run):'); console.log('  cd clients/cli && npm install && npx lolm status'); console.log('  # or: npm install -g lolm-cli   then: lolm code \"…\"'); console.log('\nRepo-ops scripts (need the project venv + env):'); for (const [k,v] of Object.entries(p.scripts)) { if (k==='help') continue; console.log('  npm run '+k); console.log('    → '+v); }"
scripts.qira:learning:pull: python3 -c "from lolm.release.learning import gather_learning; import json; print(json.dumps(gather_learning('.'), indent=2))"
scripts.preqira:hf:ingest: node -e "console.log('[lolm-ops] HF ingest — needs network + HF token; dry output if unset')"
scripts.postinstall:
node -e "console.log('
[lolm] This root package is private ops, not the product CLI.
  Product CLI:  cd clients/cli && npm install && npx lolm status
  Help:         npm run help
')"

author: Qira LLC (Bryan Leonard & Brandyn Leonard)
